say:2:1331102101:1.text: I—It's true! I overheard the adults talking about someone falling into a well and becoming undead!
say:2:1331102101:1.source_cn: 当，当然是真的！大人们说，有一个人不小心掉到井里爬不出...
say:2:1331102101:1.male: I—It's true! I overheard the adults talking about someone falling into a well and becoming undead!
say:2:1331102101:1.female: I—It's true! I overheard the adults talking about someone falling into a well and becoming undead!

say:3:1331102102:1.text: Eugene, you're making this up, aren't you?
say:3:1331102102:1.source_cn: 尤金，你一定是在瞎编，只是听大人说的而已。

say:4:1331102103:1.text: You can check out the well if you don't believe me!
say:4:1331102103:1.source_cn: 你要不信我们可以去井边去看！你趴在井边就可以看到活死人了！
